calibration.note: Structure heights from the fine-tuned model's learned metre-per-pixel scale (±40 % typical); add GCPs or a surface DEM for measured scale.

anchors.uncertainty_note: 3 m per level heuristic; roof height and local floor heights unknown

confidence_definition: exp(-spread / 2 m), spread = rotation-ensemble spread; a relative reliability index, not a probability
